title: Grok Bot Adds AI Shopping and Shared Team Accounts in Stable Update

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The latest update to the Grok Bot assistant has moved to a stable release, introducing e-commerce tools that allow the AI to search for products by price and store via a carousel interface and complete checkouts and order tracking within the chat. Version 0.77.0 also adds "Team Bots," which enables users to share account logins and secrets across an entire organization, along with new permissions settings for automated review rules.

These features expand the bot's existing capacity to handle payments and sign-ins through a secure "Vault" and its ability to place outbound phone calls to businesses. The updated terms of service for the assistant now include a dedicated section on phone calls, reflecting the rollout of these capabilities. To date, the platform has seen the creation of more than 8,600 individual bots.

Grok Bot just got a big upgrade. @mattyp walks through it on the beach:

🛒 Shopping cards: ask for "a gooseneck kettle under $80" and get a carousel with prices, stores and colors
📦 Product pages with checkout, then order tracking right in the chat
💳 Vault payments: cards, Shop Pay and X Money. It never saves your card number or code
👥 Team Bots: shared logins and secrets, share with a team or a whole org, pin them in the Library
💬 Bots ask for connector permission right in Slack
📇 Contacts in the Vault, so it fills in your address and phone for you
⚡ Faster X setup, multiple Page edits at once, cleaner Vault

The bot that does the work for you keeps getting better. 8,679 bots and counting at https://t.co/hqfm3LOZsl: https://t.co/0VXMlCYzyQ
